contentPattern.structure: one row per field: | Label | Type | Placeholder or options | Help text (optional) |
contentPattern.fieldTypes: text, email, tel, number, date, textarea, select, checkbox, radio, submit; combine with "+" (e.g. "text+text") for two inputs on one line
contentPattern.options: select/radio/checkbox options as a list or one per line; for select the first entry is the placeholder
contentPattern.textRows: single-cell rows render as heading, intro or legal text; a single-cell picture row becomes the form image

usage: Contact, consultation-request and filter forms (contact pages, product consultation forms, review filters). Used on 77 catalogued pages (reuse count 77), e.g. https://www.ergo.de/de/Geschaeftskunden-Produkte/kontakt-geschaeftskunden, https://www.ergo.de/de/Produkte/Krankenversicherung/Augenversicherung, https://www.ergo.de/de/Produkte/Krankenversicherung/gesundheitsvorsorge.
reuseGuidance: Reuse form for any data-entry form or lone select/filter control; add an option class for colour or layout differences. Form submission, validation services and any live backend integration are out of scope for now: the block renders the authored content statically.
